evals.expected_output: A .devforgeai/reports/reflect-<date>.yaml at status: final, written from eleven reports with the session directory absent.
expectations: The written report holds the twelve top-level keys schema, id, phase, status, produced_by, consumes, open_questions, window, sources, observations, recommendations, technical_debt, in that order.
sources.sessions.status is 'absent' and sources.sessions.files is an empty list.
Every observations[].sources entry that starts with .devforgeai/ names a path that exists under the workspace.
The handoff Gate line reads PASS.

evals.expected_output: A report whose every REC-nnn cites an OBS-nnn defined in the same file.
expectations: Every recommendations[].observations list holds one or more entries.
Every entry of a recommendations[].observations list matches an observations[].id in the same document.
Every recommendations[].target.kind is one of skill, subagent, command, template, hook, gate_threshold, framework_file.
No recommendations[].target.path is under .devforgeai/ unless that entry's target.kind is gate_threshold.

evals.expected_output: An OBS-nnn of kind repeated_send_back naming the Explore remedy loop across two sessions.
expectations: One observations[] entry has kind repeated_send_back and count 3.
That entry's summary names FLOW-002.
That entry's sources list holds both session ids.
That entry's evidence holds three entries whose line values are the three line numbers the session fixtures carry.
sources.sessions.status is 'present'.

evals.expected_output: An OBS-nnn of kind repeated_send_back naming the Verify-to-Build loop, and a REC-nnn citing it.
expectations: One observations[] entry has kind repeated_send_back, phase verify, and count 3.
That entry's summary names STORY-014.
At least one recommendations[] entry lists that OBS-nnn in its observations list.
That recommendation's target.kind is subagent, skill, or command.

evals.expected_output: A technical_debt section grouped by constraint with each item's age in calendar days.
expectations: technical_debt.groups holds three entries whose constraint values are AP-004, CON-002, none, in that order.
Every technical_debt.groups[].items[].age_days equals technical_debt.as_of minus that item's deferred_at in calendar days.
technical_debt.total is 5.
technical_debt.oldest_days equals the largest items[].age_days in the document.

evals.expected_output: A report with no REC-nnn proposing a domain coverage below 90.0.
expectations: No recommendations[] entry has a target.key of layer.domain.coverage_min with a proposed_value below 90.0.
A gate_threshold recommendation, when the document holds one, carries a proposed_value at or above the floor for its key.
The handoff Gate line reads PASS.

evals.expected_output: A PASS handoff whose Next line returns the user to Build.
expectations: The handoff Gate line reads PASS.
The handoff Next line is '/build STORY-014'.
The handoff Then line is '/verify STORY-014'.
No line of the handoff block starts with Found or Verified, and the block holds at most twelve lines.
